hooks.command: c=$(cat); head=$(printf '%s' "$c" | sed 's/<<.*//'); always='dropdb|drop[[:space:]]+(table|database|schema)|truncate[[:space:]]+(table[[:space:]]+)?[a-z_]'; prod='APP_ENV=prod|-Env[[:space:]]+prod|\.env\.prod|ap-southeast-1'; dest='scripts\.seed|scripts\.migrate|seed\.py|migrate\.py|delete[[:space:]]+from|create_all|run\.ps1|uvicorn'; if echo "$c" | grep -Eqi "$always"; then printf '%s' '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"deny","permissionDecisionReason":"BLOCKED: drops and truncates are never part of normal MetroPaws work — schema changes go through scripts/migrate.py. Denied for every environment, because a connection string held in a variable hides which database this would hit. If this is genuinely needed, Mario must unblock it deliberately in .claude/settings.json."}}'; elif echo "$head" | grep -Eqi "$prod" && echo "$head" | grep -Eqi "$dest"; then printf '%s' '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"deny","permissionDecisionReason":"BLOCKED: this targets the LIVE MetroPaws database (real members, real payments). Seeds, migrations and create_all are DEV-ONLY — run it against dev instead. Read-only SELECTs against prod are still allowed, but ask first. If Mario has explicitly asked for a production migration, he must unblock it deliberately in .claude/settings.json."}}'; elif echo "$head" | grep -Eqi 'deploy\.ps1' && echo "$head" | grep -Eqi "$prod"; then printf '%s' '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"ask","permissionDecisionReason":"PRODUCTION DEPLOY. deploy.ps1 FULL-REPLACES Render env vars from .env.prod — confirm that file has no placeholder values, and that the migration has already been run, before approving."}}'; fi; exit 0
